# Files and directories that must not be edited directly by Claude.
# Enforced by the protect-generated-files.sh hook.
#
# Syntax:
#   path/ending/in/   — matches directory prefix anywhere in the path
#   *.ext             — matches file extension
#   exact-name.file   — matches filename

# OpenAPI client packages (regenerate with: uv run generate-clients)
packages/generated/

# Type stubs for native extensions (generated by pycolmap build)
typings/

# Python lock files (regenerate with: uv run lock-python)
uv.lock
pylock.*.toml

# CI-generated image digest pins
.env.lock
